blockers.required_resolution: Every enabled profile has a registered production adapter and creates a session through the generic runtime.

blockers.title: Canonical Tool Broker is not the production execution boundary
blockers.required_resolution: New multi-brain and gated MCP tool calls pass grant, context, policy, confirmation, provider, postcondition, and audit through one broker.

blockers.title: Tool schemas have multiple manually maintained truth sources
blockers.required_resolution: Generate MCP and model-runtime contracts from the canonical schemas and risk metadata, with drift checks.

blockers.title: Candidate application does not atomically activate the complete runtime
